main_text.l: excretione sanguinolenta, ventrem magnis doloribus orminibusque exercens, Act.28.8.

EBRIETAS, μέθη, est effectus vinolentiæ & crapulæ, quia est tum Ligamen ipsum rationis (vt aiunt) ex nimia & immoderata vini sumptione & bibtione contingens: tum nimia ipsa vini cuiuslibet assumptio. Vide Inebriari.

EBRIETAS damnatur, Deut. 21.20. Prouerb. 20.1. & 31.4. Eccles. 10.16. Esaiæ 5. verf. 11.22. & 28.1. Luc. 21.34. Roman. 13.13. 1. Corinth. 6.10. Galat. 5.21. Ephes. 5.18. 1 Thessal. 5.8. 1. Tim. 3.3. Tit. 1.7. & 2.3. 1. Pet. 4.3. Ebrietatis incommodA, Genes. 19.32. 1. Reg. 16.9. Prouerb. 21.17. & 23.30. & 31. 1. Cor. 6.10. Iram Dei provocat, Esa 5. v. 11. 13. & 28.1. Dan. 2. Ioël. 1. v. 4.5. mentem alienat, Pro. 23.31. Eccles. 19.2. Esa. 28.7. Osee 4.11. ad libidinem incendit, Prou. 20.1. & 23.31. &c. Ephes. 5.18. facultates dissipat, Pro. 21.17. & 23.20,21. Eccles. 19.1. secreta detegit, Pro. 31.4. Abac. 2.15. ad furorem & ixas excitat, Prou. 20.1 & 23.29. Eccles. 31.40. Osee 7.5. Notet vt serpens: Prou. 23.31.32. Regno Dei excludit, 1. Cor. 6.10. Gal. 5.21

Ebrietatis exempla, Noë, Genes. 9.21. Nabal, 1. Sam. 25.36. Benadad, 20.16. (Vide COMESSATIONIS exempla.) In ebrietate extinctorum exempla: Philisthæi, Iudic. 16. v. 25.30. Amnon, 2. Sam. 13.28. Ela, 1. Reg. 16.9. Balthasar, Dan. 5. v. 1 2. 3.4.30.
[Ebrius, ebria, ærumnis & afflictionibus oppressus. Esai. 51.21. Ier. 23.9. ebria sanguine, meretrix mystica, Apoc. 17.6.]

ECCLESIA Latinis, Græcis ἐκκλησία. Primò, pro templo materiali, (vt vocant) Deu. 23.1. Iudic. 20.2. Psal. 68.27. Threni 1.10. Ioel 2.16. 1. Cor. 11.18. & 14.34. Secundò, pro familiæ alicuius domestici fidei, Rom. 16.5. 1. Cor. 16.19. Coloss. 4.15. Tertiò, pro cœtu vnius prouinciæ, 1. Reg. 8.14. Act. 9.31. & 11.26. & 12.1. & 13.1. & 15.3. & 19.32. & 20.17. Roman. 16.11. Cor. 1.2. & 16.1.2. Cor. 8.1. Gal. 1.2. 2. Thess. 1.1 &c. 1. Pet. 5.13.
